datasets.name: RapidEye images
datasets.verbatim: We generated annual landslide inventories of an area of 33 km2 by manually digitizing landslide polygons (Table 1) on seven scenes of RapidEye images (WGS 1984 UTM Zone 45N) (Planet Team 2017) acquired over the years between 2013 and 2019.

datasets.name: Landslide Inventory of Rasuwa district
datasets.verbatim: We generated annual landslide inventories of an area of 33 km2 by manually digitizing landslide polygons (Table 1) on seven scenes of RapidEye images... Two geomorphological experts manually digitized the landslides using the satellite imageries.

methods.name: U-Net deep learning model
methods.summary: A U-Net semantic segmentation network with 5 convolutional blocks and 10 convolutional layers, using transfer learning to detect landslides over time. It takes 128x128 pixel patches as input and produces a binary landslide/non-landslide mask, trained using the Adam optimizer and Tversky loss function.
methods.verbatim: We present the data and codes openly available at https://github.com/kushanavbhuyan/Multi-Temporal-Landslide-Mapping-Nepal to encourage reproducibility of the study.
